title: Vanishing boundary geometry and critical pressure compactness for the three-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations
summary: We prove boundary partial regularity for the three-dimensional nonstationary Navier--Stokes equations in bounded domains with fractional Sobolev boundary graphs whose integrability exponent is greater than three. Within the fractional Sobolev graph setting, this lowers the boundary threshold from fifteen quarters to three. We work in Breit's boundary suitable weak-solution framework, with the mixed maximal-regularity pair $(5/3,15/14)$ explicitly included in the solution assumptions.
